source_assumptions.offset_status: Illustrative radiative/advection scaling inspired by the published trend. The 1500 K normalization is a scenario choice. Values are not extracted Showman et al. GCM predictions.
source_assumptions.map: Degree-2 map made from (1 - fraction) times a uniform map plus fraction times a projected spherical Gaussian. The default width is 40 degrees and the injected fraction is 0.8. Recovery fits separate uniform and hotspot amplitudes. A dense-sphere positivity bound limits their ratio. Map normalization uses the target's subobserver latitude.
source_assumptions.noise: Independent white Gaussian noise. Explicit noise_levels_ppm values are per noise_reference_seconds (default 60 seconds) and are scaled by the square root of reference time over exposure time. No ETC or red-noise model.
source_assumptions.visit: Symmetric continuous visit centered on the supplied eclipse time, with cadence and exposure from each target. Full-window and occulted-exposure-only fits are saved separately. The forward orbit uses transit t0 half a period before the eclipse center, and the subobserver latitude follows inclination.
limitations: Fixed circular orbit and supplied geometry; no orbit uncertainty.
The injection and recovery use the same degree-2 Gaussian template family.
Profile-grid screening with BIC weights; this is not full posterior inference.
The uniform-null control has no injected hotspot and tests false map detections.

input_assumptions.noise: User-authorized white noise scenarios at 50 and 100 ppm per ideal 60 second bin; not ETC prediction
input_assumptions.depth: Photon-weighted flat-throughput blackbody band 2.9-5.1 micron; Tbrightness=1.1*Teq; not atmospheric spectrum or ETC model
input_assumptions.geometry: Fixed circular representative geometry. Dated 2025-08-13 composite archive ratios and a/Rstar; inclinations checked against live NASA default 2026-10-09; periods from accepted PID10786 APT. Composite values can mix literature solutions. No orbit uncertainty or eccentricity recovery.
input_assumptions.visit: Symmetric continuous visit about eclipse, length equals APT total science exposure seconds. Ideal 60-second bins with no gaps; not measured timestamps.
input_assumptions.trend: delta=atan(tan(40 degrees)*(1500 K/Teq)^3). Illustrative radiative/advection scaling inspired by Showman2020; normalization chosen for simulation, not extracted GCM prediction.
input_assumptions.science: Band brightness hot spot longitude, not pressure-specific temperature offset or phase-curve peak; profile-grid screening, not full NUTS validation.

analysis.recovery_contrast: free non-negative uniform and hotspot amplitudes

files.profiles_fit_scope: full_window only; eclipse_only profile intervals and BIC are in recovery_trials.csv
